about: Helpers a captain can hire in cantinas. Four bunks. What each one does is in cargo.py (Ship.crew); who they are is here.

loader.name: Shunt
loader.about: a KRO-series junior loader: two tonnes, four arms, stacks a hold ten per cent tighter than anyone else

steward.name: Ambrose
steward.about: a steward unit from a scrapped Neon liner; too polite for a hauler and aware of it; passengers pay more

mechanic.name: Oksana
mechanic.about: ex-legion fitter; patches the hull after fights and knows where the cheap parts are

gunner.name: Tadeo Ruiz
gunner.about: ex-militia gunner who left because the militia never shot at anything; +1 attack

navigator.name: Sister Iolanthe
navigator.about: a Solarian navigator who reads lanes in sunspots and is right often enough to be annoying; better escapes, storm lanes

broker.name: Old Fenn
broker.about: a dock broker who has haggled at every market in five systems and been banned from two; 2% less trade tax

crew.loader.title: A loader looking for work
crew.loader.text: A small loader agrobot stands by the bar, holding its own job advert in two of its four arms. It is called {loader}. It has read your manifest. 'Your stowage wastes a tenth of the hold,' it says. 'I would not waste it.'

variants.text: A small loader agrobot stands by the bar, holding its own job advert. It is called {loader}, a KRO-series junior. '{krog} sent me,' it says. '{krog} said your hold was a disgrace and that I should fix it. I would like to fix it.'

crew.steward.title: A steward without a liner
crew.steward.text: A steward robot in a jacket three sizes too formal is polishing glasses that belong to the bar. Its liner was scrapped last month. '{steward},' it says, and bows. 'I hear your passengers eat from the tin. I could change that. I would rather change that than polish these.'

crew.mechanic.title: A fitter between contracts
crew.mechanic.text: A woman with burn scars on both forearms is explaining to the bartender why his cooler is about to die. She is right; it dies while she talks. {mechanic} did eight years as a legion fitter. 'I fix what I swear at,' she says. 'Your ship sounds like it needs a lot of swearing.'

choices.say: Hire {mechanic.short} (6,000 credits; repairs after fights, cheaper refits)

crew.gunner.title: A gunner who wants to shoot
crew.gunner.text: {gunner} spent six years on a militia cutter and fired the guns twice, both times at a drill target. He saw your hull on the way in. 'Somebody has been shooting at you,' he says, cheerfully. 'I would like to shoot back.'

crew.navigator.title: A Solarian navigator
crew.navigator.text: {navigator} wears the Solarian sun on a chain and a star chart for a scarf. She reads the lanes in sunspots, which sounds like nonsense, and she gets you through storms, which does not. 'The sun keeps a timetable,' she says. 'Nobody else reads it.'

choices.say: Hire {navigator.short} (5,000 credits; better escapes, storm lanes)

crew.broker.title: An old broker
crew.broker.text: {broker} has haggled at every market in five systems and been banned from two. He is not sure which two. He watched you sell this morning and winced twice. 'You pay the dock what the dock asks,' he says. 'Nobody pays the dock what the dock asks.'
